item.title: When to see the 'very rare' raptor making a comeback to Norfolk
item.description: The perfect time to spot the mysterious, once nearly extinct goshawk making a quiet return to Norfolk is approaching.

item.title: 'Lovely little slice of Italy' revealed as the highest-rated pizza spot in Norwich
item.description: Saporita in Norwich has been rated the best place in the city for a pizza by Tripadvisor.

item.title: Football stadium revamp among public notices to be aware of in Norfolk
item.description: From controversial plans to revamp Carrow Road to new flats being approved in Norwich, here are five public notices to be aware of in Norfolk.

item.title: Detectives still investigating after man attacked by Riverside
item.description: Detectives are still investigating an attack at Riverside which left a man with serious injuries.

item.title: REVEALED: Opening date for new three-storey salon in the city
item.description: Charlotte Sims, behind Charisma Beauty, has revealed when she will open her new, larger salon, offering treatments including Korean head spa.

item.title: Frazzled neighbours fed up with 'unprecedented' number of power cuts
item.description: People living on Patterson Close have been unable to make a cup of tea or in some cases, keep their oxygen machine running, following a number of power cuts.

item.title: Owner of four-legged social media star reveals secret to 100k fans
item.description: Laura Summers, a dog mum with more than 100k social media followers, has revealed the secret to her success online, hailing dog-friendly businesses.

item.title: Primary school children among pupils suspended for drugs in Norfolk, figures reveal
item.description: New figures have revealed the number of children receiving treatment for drug abuse, with primary school pupils among those suspended from school due to drugs.

item.title: New homes approved in 'Thomas the Tank Engine' village
item.description: Three new homes have been given the green light in the Norfolk village whose vicar penned the much-loved Thomas the Tank Engine stories.

item.title: Education trust under fire over new plans warns of 'unavoidable changes' ahead
item.description: Financial pressures are mounting for Synergy Multi Academy Trust, which has begun staff consultations across sites in Norfolk.
